values.note: 2026: $50 a night for two guests (every site has full hookups); extra guests $2 (ages 5-17) or $5 (18+). Bi-weekly and monthly rates on request. Extra vehicles or trailers kept at the site $10 a night (free overflow lot).

values.note: Showers and restrooms open 23 hours a day (closed noon-1 for cleaning); 24/7 laundry in season ($3.50 a load). Wi-Fi is free but unpredictable; no cable TV in the valley. Camp store with RV supplies, ice, propane and firewood; pavilion; ADA accessible.

note: Family-run since 1993 at 1245 County Rd 30, Lake City (9,000 ft), in the San Juans on a bench above the Lake Fork of the Gunnison; sites overlook the river valley but are set back from the water. Jeep rentals on site; Monday potluck, Friday donuts. The operator asks guests to follow its own directions rather than GPS routing. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $50 for two (2026), June 1 - Oct 1 season (added dates), 34 sites, 20/30/50-amp full hookups, showers, laundry. Added 45-ft maximum, wifi, camp store, phone/availability-form booking up to a year ahead. Gate: $50 is not over US$50 (no mandatory per-night extras for two people); no gateway within 40 km (Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP 71 km); not stayed at. Presence: own website with phone 970-944-2878; Google Maps 4.8 stars / 110 reviews. Not long-stay in character (nightly rate posted; monthly on request). Elk Fire notice on the home page (Aug 24) says the fire does not affect camping. Note: dropped field repeats (sites, hookups, amenities, season, price, the RV Life line).
